Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing requirement for reporting reprimands and stayed suspensions against certificated staff.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting reprimands and stayed suspensionsagainst certificated staff; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.410RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.410RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of reporting disciplinary actions taken againstcertificated staff to other states via a national data base used by theoffice of the superintendent of public instruction, reprimands andstayed suspensions shall be reported to the same extent thatsuspensions and revocations are reported.
